name: dev.pacxio/pacxio
title: Pacxio
description: Packaging prepress for coding agents: editable dielines, 3D, workbench, and print-ready files.

environmentVariables.name: PACXIO_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Output language for CLI, MCP, and workbench messages (en or zh).

environmentVariables.name: PACXIO_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory for local pacxio state, cloud login credentials, fonts, and workbench preferences.

environmentVariables.name: PACXIO_CLOUD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token for the pacxio cloud service (normally obtained via interactive `pacxio login`).

environmentVariables.name: PACXIO_CLOUD_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional override URL for the pacxio cloud service.

environmentVariables.name: PACXIO_AUTO_UPDATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to disable background auto-updates for unpinned `uv tool install pacxio` installations.
